The aggregate replaces, rather than supplements, nine-times per-message authority, so assistant bytes are not multiplied or double counted; the existing maximum of nine prior assistant messages remains an independent count bound. Measuring assembled and replay contributions after final UTF-8 serialization makes the equal assembled/per-message limits coherent with complete unchanged DeepSeek reasoning/content/tool-call replay, while measuring the full body again immediately before transport closes serialization and envelope drift. The plan preserves the 65,536-byte candidate/evidence/schema limits, 81,920-byte declaration limit, 131,072-byte prepared-initial limit, 393,216-byte tool-result limit, 32,768-token setting, ten turns, eight navigation calls, two submissions, five-/25-minute deadlines, zero SDK retries, one durable retry, atomic immutable commit/replay, local code-logic/file-v2 authority, source-free-before-source qualification, Story 12.4/12.5 exclusions, and CodeGraphContext exclusion. Task regeneration and every later definition, implementation-approval, TDD, qualification, convergence, quality, E2E, verification, lifecycle, staging, and commit gate remain unwaived.
